name: Perkin reaction
conditions: Acetic anhydride, sodium acetate; heat; hydrolytic work-up
easy: Aromatic aldehyde ને anhydride-derived enolate સાથે જોડીએ છીએ. Elimination અને hydrolysis પછી α,β-unsaturated carboxylic acid મળે છે.
insight: Anhydride enolate addition is followed by oxygen acylation, elimination and hydrolysis. The acylated oxygen is a better leaving group than free hydroxide.
stereo: The E cinnamic acid is the usual major isolated product in this example.
trap: Perkin માં anhydride donor છે; Claisen condensation માં ester donor/acceptor અને crossed aldol માં aldehyde/ketone partners હોય છે.

mechanismSteps.body: Anhydride ના α-H પરથી enolate બને છે.
Enolate aromatic aldehyde પર C–C bond બનાવે છે.
O-acylation પછી β-elimination unsaturated anhydride આપે છે.
Hydrolytic work-up cinnamic acid આપે છે.

name: Secondary-amine N-nitrosation
conditions: Nitrous acid in acidic medium; conceptual reaction
easy: Secondary amine ના N પરનો H nitroso group થી replace થાય છે. Product N–N=O ધરાવતો N-nitrosamine છે; diazonium salt નથી.
insight: Nitrosating electrophile formation, amine attack at nitrogen, then deprotonation give an N-nitrosamine.
stereo: No stereocentre is created in the dimethylamine example.
trap: PDF માં માત્ર nitrosamine formation છે. Liebermann colour test માં subsequent phenol/acid chemistry અને acid–base colour changes પણ આવે છે; બંનેને એક elementary step ન ગણો.

mechanismSteps.body: Acidic nitrous acid nitrosating electrophile આપે છે.
Available amine lone pair electrophilic nitrogen પર attack કરે છે.
N–H deprotonation neutral nitrosamine આપે છે.
Liebermann colour response subsequent test chemistry છે.

name: Hunsdiecker reaction
conditions: Silver carboxylate, Br₂; classical thermal/photochemical conditions
easy: Carboxyl group નો carbon CO₂ તરીકે નીકળે છે. બાકી alkyl fragment પર Br આવે છે; product માં starting acid કરતાં one carbon ઓછો રહે છે.
insight: Acyl hypobromite formation, O–Br homolysis, decarboxylation and radical bromine-atom transfer form the classical chain model.
stereo: A radical centre generally does not preserve a pre-existing stereocentre at that reacting carbon.
trap: Propanoate gives bromoethane, not 1-bromopropane. Hunsdiecker and soda-lime decarboxylation have different products.

mechanismSteps.body: Silver carboxylate થી acyl hypobromite બને છે.
O–Br bond homolysis acyloxy radical આપે છે.
CO₂ loss થી alkyl radical મળે છે.
Bromine-atom transfer alkyl bromide આપે છે.

name: Claisen condensation
easy: એક ester નું enolate બીજા ester ના carbonyl પર attack કરે છે. Ethoxide નીકળે એટલે β-keto ester બને છે.
insight: Acyl substitution, rather than simple aldol addition, follows the tetrahedral intermediate. Product deprotonation drives the equilibrium; acid work-up restores the neutral β-keto ester.
stereo: No persistent stereocentre is created in ethyl acetoacetate.
trap: A full equivalent of base is normally needed for this classical self-condensation. Match the alkoxide to the ester; Claisen rearrangement is a different pericyclic reaction.

mechanismSteps.body: Ethoxide α-H કાઢીને ester enolate બનાવે છે.
Enolate બીજા ester પર attack કરીને tetrahedral intermediate આપે છે.
C=O restore થતાં ethoxide leaves.
Doubly activated product deprotonation equilibrium આગળ ધપાવે છે.
Acid work-up neutral β-keto ester આપે છે.

name: Benzoin condensation
easy: Benzaldehyde પાસે α-H ન હોવા છતાં cyanide catalyst carbonyl carbon ને nucleophilic donor બનાવી શકે છે. આ polarity reversal ને umpolung કહે છે.
insight: Cyanohydrin formation, carbon deprotonation, attack on a second aldehyde, proton transfers and cyanide elimination regenerate the catalyst.
stereo: Achiral cyanide catalysis gives racemic benzoin; the new alcohol stereocentre is unspecified in the drawing.
trap: આ ordinary enolate aldol નથી. Product α-hydroxy ketone છે; β-hydroxy carbonyl નથી. Catalyst CN⁻ final product માં retained રહેતું નથી.

mechanismSteps.body: CN⁻ aldehyde પર add થાય છે.
Proton transfers cyanohydrin-derived carbon nucleophile આપે છે.
તે બીજા benzaldehyde પર C–C bond બનાવે છે.
Solvent-mediated proton transfers પછી cyanide elimination C=O restore કરે છે.

name: Diazotization of aniline
easy: Primary aromatic amine નું –NH₂ group cold acidic nitrous acid થી –N₂⁺ group બને છે. Diazonium salt પછી substitution અથવા azo coupling માટે ઉપયોગી છે.
insight: N-nitrosation, solvent-mediated tautomerization to diazohydroxide, O-protonation and dehydration form the diazonium ion.
stereo: No tetrahedral stereocentre is involved in this aromatic example.
trap: Primary aliphatic diazonium salts behave differently and decompose readily. Secondary amines form nitrosamines; they do not follow this same final step.

mechanismSteps.body: NaNO₂/HCl થી nitrous acid અને nitrosating species બને છે.
Aniline nitrogen પર N-nitrosation થાય છે.
Proton transfers થી diazohydroxide બને છે.
OH protonation તેને water leaving group બનાવે છે.
Water loss diazonium ion આપે છે; Cl⁻ counterion છે.
